name: GaussianObject
definition: A method that initializes 3D Gaussians with a visual hull and fine-tunes a pre-trained ControlNet to repair degraded rendered images generated by adding noise to each Gaussian's attributes.
summary: GaussianObject reconstructs 3D Gaussian Splatting from sparse inputs by initializing Gaussians with a visual hull and fine-tuning a pre-trained ControlNet to repair degraded images.
